# `check-pr-labels.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| allow_fork_prs | Allow fork PRs to run this workflow (set false for self-hosted runners) | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| require_all_labels | If true, PR must have ALL specified labels. If false, ANY label is sufficient. | `boolean` | `false` | no |
| require_merged | If true, PR must be merged. If false, just check labels. | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| required_labels | Comma-separated list of labels required (e.g., "build-docker,deploy") | `string` | `build-docker` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |



## Outputs

| Name | Description |
| :--- | :---------- |
| conditions_met | Whether all conditions are met (true/false) |
| has_required_labels | Whether the PR has required labels (true/false) |
| pr_labels | Comma-separated list of PR labels |
| pr_merged | Whether the PR was merged (true/false) |
